response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS amount_avg, AVG(t.balance) AS balance_avg FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(amount_avg) AS amount_avg, AVG(balance_avg) AS balance_avg FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount_avg) AS mean_amount_avg FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.amount_avg, r.balance_avg, r.amount_avg / o.mean_amount_avg AS amount_avg_ratio FROM region_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_amount_avg IS NOT NULL AND o.mean_amount_avg <> 0

assumptions.assumption: Transaction amount means the stored unsigned amount; accounts with no credit or withdrawal transactions have a NULL amount average, which AVG excludes.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat withdrawals as negative amounts when calculating average transaction amount.
